decision_conditions: Enlargement of a dwelling house - The operations comprising a rear dormer would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class B of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class B. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Alteration to the roof of the dwelling house (Class C) - The operations would consist of the installation of 3 rooflights which would result in the alteration to the roof of the dwelling house within the meaning of Class C of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class C. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Soil Vent Pipe (Class G) - The operations comprising the alteration of a soil vent pipe and would consist of any other alteration to the dwelling house within the meaning of Class G of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class G. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.
description: APPLICATION FOR A CERTIFICATE OF LAWFULNESS FOR PROPOSED ERECTION OF A REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION AND INSERTION OF X3 ROOFLIGHTS TO FRONT ROOFSLOPE
